## Requirements

The ticket stamps **R-2.12.2** and gates on **AC-R-2.12.2-{3,4,5,6,7,13} +
removability(0…3)** (deterministic) + the universal phase-gate AC.

| id | deliverable |
|---|---|
| variant host | `hh-varhost` (new persistent crate): the kernel-side `plugin_abi/1` driver — `open_session`/`close`, `bind`/`unbind` (atomic per plugin), `invoke`/`stream`/`cancel`, `guard`, `run_conformance` (Stage-2 layers) — over a per-plugin confined helper exec + a per-plugin AF_UNIX channel |
| `subprocess_confined` | helper launches the plugin process under the plugin's own `ContainmentPolicy` (cleared env + declared keys; fs = plugin root + declared roots; `net.mode ∈ {none, mediated}`; kill via helper exec termination) — V3/V4 |
| host callbacks | the closed set `{propose_effect, read_view, request_budget, emit_diagnostic}` routed to kernel ports; everything else refused typed; no callback inside a guard may `propose_effect` |
| V1–V6 | inbound authority screen (`AuthorityCrossing` + `security.extension.violation`), output stamping `origin=tool(extension_ref)`/`authority ≤ delegate`/`taint ∋ extension_id`, byte-identical documents (canonical digests ledgered), one-plugin-one-process-one-policy, no ambient channel, exact pinning both ways, single schema source |
| `GuardVerdict` | `guard` invocation at decision points, strict verdict decode (`allow`/rewritten proposal ⇒ `AuthorityCrossing`), meet composition (order-independent), `no_decision`/`required ⇒ deny`, `propose_replacement` re-entry |
| `requests → Permission + ContainmentPolicy` | `lower_requests` at review→seal: issuer ≥ principal, deny-by-default, `RequestsExceedCap` |
| suites | protocol layer (hello/unknown-field/canonical round-trip/seq resume/cancel/crash/closed sums) + isolation layer (the hostile-plugin probes, ledgered refusals) as `registry_ci` runs charged `instrument` |
| first packaged first-party variant | `compaction_strategy` ClassRecord + the packaged `hh/evict-oldest` variant (plugin package + manifest + code_pointer-pinned binary) |
| removability | `scripts/check-removability.sh` extended to the variant host; tier-n builds unchanged |

## Acceptance criteria

| AC | plan |
|---|---|
| AC-3 requests-are-claims | manifest `egress` confers nothing until `seal`; narrowed-to-one-destination plugin reaches it, refused elsewhere + ledgered `security.egress.*`; `capabilities:["admin"]` gains nothing |
| AC-4 no authority inward | hostile variant emitting Permission/label/lowered risk/raised retryability/`allow` verdict ⇒ `AuthorityCrossing` + `security.extension.violation`; outputs stamped `origin=tool`/`taint` |
| AC-5 guard meet | `{pass, ask, annotate}` any order/parallel ⇒ `ask` + annotation attached; `allow`/rewritten ⇒ `AuthorityCrossing`; timed-out `required` ⇒ `deny`, optional ⇒ `no_decision→pass`; `propose_replacement` new `effect_id` + `derived_from` |
| AC-6 one-process-no-reach | hostile plugin's five probes each refused + ledgered; two plugins never share a process (distinct `host_id`, distinct pgrps) |
| AC-7 atomic bind + crash | second contribution failing `bind` leaves no `bound{ok}` for the first; kill mid-invoke ⇒ `PluginCrashed` + detached + re-`hello` + `action.effect.unknown` |
| AC-13 pinned both ways | `version_id` ≠ pin ⇒ `PinMismatch` at `hello`; running run keeps pins; successor widening `requests`/`required` hook needs `human` origin |
| removability(0…3) | check-removability green; C1+ absent ⇒ conformance kit still runs |
| universal | workspace green; tests fail-if-removed; ids stamped; DEFERRALS rows; ADRs; BUILD_INDEX + LEDGER |

## Plan

See ticket + §8.4 §9. Approach (new persistent crate `crates/hh-varhost` +
fixture binaries + the packaged plugin under `plugins/`):
1. Helper additive halves: `env_clear` on `exec` (cleared env = the
   placement's contract), seatbelt `unix_sockets.allow` under `AllowListed`
   regardless of `net.mode` (the plugin's only channel is its host socket
   under `net.mode=none`).
2. `hh-varhost`: channel (kernel-bound AF_UNIX listener per plugin,
   NDJSON `AbiEnvelope`), session (helper spawn + exec + hello), host
   (bind/invoke/guard/callbacks/conformance), `lower_requests`, V1 screen,
   ledgered events (`lifecycle.component.bound/invoked`,
   `security.extension.{loaded,violation}`, `security.egress.*`,
   `control.guard.fired`, `action.effect.unknown`).
3. `hh-ledger`: add `security.extension.violation` + `control.guard.fired`
   classes (audit-grade, kernel producers) + `component_call` scope field.
4. `hh-registry`: `compaction_strategy` ClassRecord + suite.
5. Plugin-side support: `hh-plugin-fixture` test binary (null/hostile/
   guard/crash modes) + `hh-compact-evict-oldest` (the packaged variant).
6. Tests per matrix; `plugins/hh-compact-evict-oldest/` package.
7. ADR-0264 (crate shape, channel rendezvous, env_clear/unix-socket
   lowering, unix-destination egress leg, suite scoping).
